distribution: 福建建阳大竹岚，海拔约一千零五十米。
en: Soldiers are yellow on the head and pale yellow on thorax and abdomen, sparsely covered with short hair. The capsule is rectangular with nearly parallel sides and raised frontal peaks. The labrum resembles a hexagonal tortoise shell, with a broad triangular translucent tip, six setae of similar length arranged as apical, lateral and subapical pairs, and four long hairs on the ridge. Mandibles are slightly curved at the tip, and more than twenty setae occupy the pronotal disc.
soldier: 兵蚁头部黄色，胸部与腹部淡黄，全身稀被短毛。头壳长方形，两侧接近平行，额峰隆起。上唇形似六角形的龟甲，唇端半透明区作宽三角形，端毛、侧端毛与亚端毛合计六根且长度约略相等，唇脊毛四根相当长。上颚末端稍弯，外缘基部的峰很小。下颚内颚叶缘毛约九根。触角十四至十六节。后颏的狭区比较宽。前胸背板前缘与后缘的凹入都较深，中区毛在二十根以上。
